worldcombat.skill.darkpulse.summary: Squeezes a malevolent aura out of its chest and pushes it toward a chosen patch of ground; on arrival it bursts into a field, each foe caught takes a hit and may flinch, and a lingering malice stays at the landing. Creeping covers wider and longer but lighter; condensed flies faster and hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.darkpulse.use.1: Open at range and chip them down
worldcombat.skill.darkpulse.use.2: Fluster whoever closed in with the malice field
When the aura bursts, each foe within %2$s blocks of the landing takes about %1$s power; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
Carries the aura onto ground within %1$s blocks, flying at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s block hit radius.
A caught foe has a %1$s flinch chance for %2$s s.
The landing is left as a malice field for %1$s s.
worldcombat.skill.darkpulse.creep.on: Creeping on: the aura flies slower, its radius is about 30%% larger, it lingers longer and flinches more, but deals about 15%% less power with a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.darkpulse.creep.off: Creeping off: faster and tighter, about 15%% more power and a shorter cooldown, best for picking off a lone target.
worldcombat.skill.darkpulse.timing: Carry the aura onto ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.darkpulse.growth.0: At level %1$s the aura rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of reach.
worldcombat.skill.darkpulse.growth.1: At level %1$s the aura rises to %2$s power, %3$s blocks of radius, and the flinch chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.darkpulse.preference.c: On: the aura flies slower, lands wider and longer and flinches more, but deals about 15%% less power with a longer cooldown, for covering an area. Off: faster, tighter and about 15%% heavier, for picking off a lone target.
worldcombat.skill.darkpulse.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; higher opens at range but gives the target time to step out before the aura arrives.
With this on, the companion raises darkpulse when another foe stands within 3.5 blocks of the target, so one burst covers them all; off keeps the normal ranged order.
